headline: Public hearings on repairs at 55 Kearney Square (Valve Island) and 145 Pawtucket Street (North Canal Waste Gatehouse).
summary: The board will hold two public hearings on repair projects by Boott Hydropower, LLC. Other business includes development reviews, hearings, orders, compliance requests, the 2027 schedule, and election of officers.
items: Public hearing DLHD-27-18: 55 Kearney Square (Valve Island), repairs to stabilize the intake channel and remove fallen granite stones, by Boott Hydropower, LLC
Public hearing DLHD-27-19: 145 Pawtucket Street (North Canal Waste Gatehouse), repair of the canal wall, by Boott Hydropower, LLC
location: Mayor’s Reception Room, Lowell City Hall, 375 Merrimack Street

1. PUBLIC HEARINGS 
  
A. DLHD-27-18: 55 Kearney Square (Valve Island) 
An application for a Historic Permit has been submitted by Boott Hydropower, LLC to implement repairs to stabilize 
the intake channel and remove existing granite stones that have fallen in the channel in the vicinity of 55 Kearney 
Square (Valve Island). The property is located in the Downtown Lowell Historic District. The project requires a 
Major Development Permit pursuant to the Lowell Historic District Act (Chapter 566, Acts of 1983). 
 
B. DLHD-27-19: 145 Pawtucket Street (North Canal Waste Gatehouse) 
An application for a Historic Permit has been submitted by Boott Hydropower, LLC to repair the canal wall in the 
vicinity of 145 Pawtucket Street (North Canal Waste Gatehouse). The property is located in the Downtown Lowell 
Historic District. The project requires a Major Development Permit pursuant to the Lowell Historic District Act 
(Chapter 566, Acts of 1983).
